role: retrospective fixed-rule comparison on eight already inspected spatial-refinement FD sources
candidate_pool: union of all coarse nodes and all nodes evaluated in the three fixed refinement rounds, deduplicated; identical for arrival, waveform, and hybrid scores
waveform_score: Frozen waveform_losses(data[::2,::8], receivers[::2], times[::8]) normalized by full-observation RMS; candidate origin from clipped median corrected FMM picks
limits: These eight events have been inspected for FMM accuracy. This is a fixed-rule retrospective diagnostic, not a new independent holdout or proof of MoE superiority. No weights or scoring parameters are fitted here.
